text: The last stanza repeats the first four lines word for word. It is not laziness; it is a test. Play the opening again, and see what has changed. Now the old guard hold a regal parade, and heralds announce her name: the establishment is opening its ranks to honour her. And at that very moment, the wish to follow men warped in her, twisted out of shape like damp wood. The final image is an absence: the homage was left waiting for me. No speech, no slammed door. She is simply elsewhere.
